statement: The recorded value is not safe and correct for this case, because the access record states "open, cleared for open publication," but the participants consented only to access on request, which would require a restricted setting.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the "open" access right contradicts the stated consent ("participants consented only to access on request") and names the correct setting as restricted.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
